name: Rustic furniture designs LLC
old_description: We’re grateful for every family that invites our work into their home.
about:
Rustic Furniture Designs LLC is based in Orrville, Ohio, where it designs and builds solid wood furniture for the residential market. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its website presents a catalog of artisan pieces intended to last for generations.

The workshop produces a range of furniture including dining tables, chairs, barstools, hutches, TV stands, wall shelves, charcuterie boards, and specialty items such as fishing pole racks. All pieces are made from solid wood — oak, reclaimed wood, and mixed hardwoods — with no veneers or particle board. The company also accepts custom orders, allowing customers to request tailored dimensions or designs.

Rustic Furniture Designs sells directly to homeowners through its e-commerce site, organizing its catalog into Farmhouse, Midcentury, and Modern collections. Prices range from $30 for small accessories to $1,640 for multi-piece sets. The company does not list commercial or institutional clients.

The business distinguishes itself by emphasizing handcrafted construction and material integrity. Its marketing highlights the absence of engineered wood products and the option for custom work, positioning each piece as an heirloom-quality investment.
